platform.heroH1: From raw audio to actionable insight, in one pipeline
platform.heroSub: Homayar ingests your call recordings, transcribes them with high accuracy, runs them through a coordinated team of AI agents, and delivers scores, risks, and coaching guidance to the people who can act on them.

pipeline.title: Ingest
pipeline.description: Calls arrive via API, scheduled sync from your telephony or contact-center platform, or direct file upload. Homayar handles common audio formats, stereo and mono recordings, and high-volume batch imports.

pipeline.title: Transcribe
pipeline.description: Speech-to-text converts every call into a speaker-separated, timestamped transcript. Channel separation distinguishes agent from customer; noisy audio and domain vocabulary are handled with configurable language models.

pipeline.title: Multi-agent analysis
pipeline.description: Seven specialized AI agents work the transcript in parallel: evaluating quality, checking compliance, detecting issues, reading sentiment, and extracting business signals. Each agent cites the transcript evidence behind its findings.

pipeline.title: Score
pipeline.description: Every call receives a quality score against your own rubric — greeting, discovery, resolution, tone, closure, and any custom criteria. Scores are consistent, explainable, and linked to the exact moments that earned or lost points.

pipeline.title: Surface insights
pipeline.description: Findings roll up into dashboards: issue topics trending across thousands of calls, sentiment shifts by team or product line, compliance exposure, and the operational root causes behind repeat contacts.

pipeline.title: Coach
pipeline.description: For each agent, Homayar builds a profile of strengths and development areas, then generates concrete coaching recommendations with example calls attached — ready for a supervisor's next one-on-one.

security.title: Security and deployment, enterprise-grade by default

items.title: Encryption everywhere
items.description: Audio, transcripts, and analysis results are encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Sensitive fields such as payment card numbers can be automatically redacted from transcripts.

items.title: Access control and audit
items.description: Role-based access control with SSO/SAML support. Every view, export, and configuration change is recorded in an immutable audit log, so you always know who accessed which call and when.

items.title: Data residency and retention
items.description: Configurable retention windows per data type — keep transcripts longer than audio, or purge both on your schedule. Deployment options support regional data-residency requirements.

items.title: Flexible deployment
items.description: Run Homayar as managed cloud, single-tenant private cloud, or fully on-premises for regulated environments such as banking, healthcare, and government. Same platform, your infrastructure rules.

architecture.title: Built to sit alongside your stack, not replace it
architecture.description: Homayar integrates with your existing telephony, CRM, and BI tools through APIs and scheduled exports. The platform is horizontally scalable — from a few hundred calls a day to hundreds of thousands — with processing isolation per tenant and no agent-side software to install. Your recordings stay under your governance; Homayar adds the analysis layer on top.

aiAgents.heroH1: Meet the team that listens to every call
aiAgents.heroSub: Homayar isn't one model summarizing audio. It's seven specialized AI agents — each with a defined role, each citing evidence, each checking the others' work — collaborating on every single call.

agents.name: Listener
agents.description: Listener is the first agent on every call. It validates the recording, separates speakers, detects hold time, silence, talk-over, and audio defects, and prepares the call for accurate downstream analysis. If a recording is unusable, Listener flags it instead of letting bad data pollute your metrics.
capabilities: Speaker separation and channel mapping (agent vs. customer)
Hold, silence, dead-air, and talk-over detection
Audio quality validation and unusable-recording flagging
Call segmentation for long or transferred conversations

agents.name: Scribe
agents.description: Scribe converts speech to a precise, timestamped, speaker-attributed transcript. It handles domain vocabulary, numbers, and names carefully, and structures the conversation into phases — opening, discovery, resolution, closure — that every other agent builds on.
capabilities: High-accuracy speech-to-text with timestamps and speaker labels
Custom vocabulary for products, plans, and industry terms
Conversation phase detection (opening, discovery, resolution, closure)
Automatic redaction of sensitive data such as card numbers

agents.name: Judge
agents.description: Judge evaluates each call against your QA scorecard — the same rubric your human reviewers use today. It scores every criterion with linked transcript evidence and applies the rubric identically across thousands of calls, eliminating reviewer drift.
capabilities: Scorecard evaluation with per-criterion evidence citations
Consistent scoring calibrated to your QA team's standards
Confidence flags that route borderline calls to human review
Score trend tracking per agent, team, and queue

agents.name: Guardian
agents.description: Guardian checks every call for regulatory and policy adherence: required disclosures, identity verification, prohibited language, and complaint-handling obligations. High-severity findings are escalated the same day with full evidence attached.
capabilities: Configurable compliance rules and mandatory-script verification
Prohibited-phrase and high-risk-language detection
Complaint, dispute, and escalation identification
Same-day alerting with audit-ready evidence trails

agents.name: Scout
agents.description: Scout hunts for what customers are actually telling you: product problems, process failures, churn signals, competitor mentions, and emerging complaint topics. It tags each call so patterns become visible across thousands of conversations.
capabilities: Issue and intent classification across every call
Churn-risk and dissatisfaction signal detection
Competitor and pricing mention tracking
Emerging-topic discovery before issues become trends

agents.name: Coach
agents.description: Coach translates analysis into growth. It builds a strengths-and-gaps profile for each agent from their own real calls, then produces specific, transcript-backed coaching recommendations a supervisor can deliver in the next one-on-one. Coach celebrates what's working as deliberately as it flags what isn't.
capabilities: Per-agent skill profiles built from real call evidence
Specific coaching recommendations with example call moments
Best-call highlighting for peer learning and recognition
Progress tracking across coaching cycles

agents.name: Analyst
agents.description: Analyst aggregates everything the other agents find into the numbers leadership needs: quality trends, issue-driver rankings, sentiment movement, compliance exposure, and the operational root causes behind repeat contacts. It turns a call center's daily noise into a measurable system.
capabilities: Cross-call trend analysis for topics, sentiment, and scores
Root-cause rollups connecting calls to products and processes
Scheduled executive and operational reporting
Exports and API access for your BI stack

orchestration.title: How the team works a call
orchestration.description: When a call arrives, Listener validates and prepares the audio, then hands a clean recording to Scribe for transcription. The structured transcript fans out to Judge, Guardian, Scout, and Coach in parallel — each analyzing from its own specialty and citing the transcript moments behind every finding. Where agents disagree — for example, Judge scores a call well but Guardian flags a missed disclosure — the conflict is surfaced for human review rather than silently averaged away. Analyst collects the verified results from every call into trends, dashboards, and reports. The whole pass completes in minutes, and every conclusion traces back to evidence you can hear for yourself.
